pages.raw_meta: Fortive is a diverse global team working together to innovate essential technologies for a safer, more productive world.
raw_blocks: Essential technologies for a safer , more productive world.
We’re a global team, 10,000 strong, with a shared purpose and clear focus. We believe in the power of working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
We solve critical challenges in industrial and healthcare settings. When safety and productivity matter most, our essential technologies deliver.
Elevating the standard of care

Fortive technologies ensure medical device safety, protect against radiation exposure, and automate critical workflows. From infection prevention to intelligent automation, we help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
Powering safer, more efficient operations
Fortive technologies detect hazards, prevent failures before they happen, and resolve issues quickly. From gas detection to predictive maintenance, we help keep people safe and systems running.
Though we’re spread around the globe, we’re united by a powerful continuous improvement mindset. At Fortive, anything is possible.

We see a sustainable future as a world that’s safe and productive for all. We're more focused than ever on protecting the planet, investing in our teams and communities, and working and sourcing responsibly.
For you. For us. For growth.
We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference. Ready to move your career forward?
We believe that prioritizing trust, sustainability, and positive impact creates long-term value.

pages.raw_title: Our Work | Intelligent Operating Solutions | Fortive
pages.raw_meta: Our forward-looking companies lead the way in software-enabled workflows, applied intelligence, advanced analytics, and other rapidly evolving technologies.
raw_blocks: Essential technologies for a safer, more productive world

We partner with our customers to drive the future of industrial and healthcare safety and productivity. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions.
"Every single one of our 10,000 colleagues across the company are really propelled by the passion to save lives and to make the world productive."

Our operating companies are known for their industry-leading positions and trusted brands. We group them into two strategic segments to focus on specific technologies and markets, but at Fortive the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. Our strong culture and the power of the Fortive Business System (FBS) catalyze innovation and growth across the portfolio.

At hospitals, healthcare facilities, and laboratories, delivering exceptional care efficiently while navigating rapid change is more important than ever. They need advanced technologies to ensure that critical safety standards are met, instruments are operating at peak performance, and complex procedures are followed accurately in a dynamic environment.
These businesses help raise the standard of care globally, keep healthcare settings safe, and ensure that providers can focus on the best possible care for their patients.
Advanced healthcare test and measurement

From smart office buildings and universities to high-tech construction sites and warehouses, these businesses deliver advanced instrumentation and software to ensure safety and compliance, improve energy efficiency, and optimize performance.

Connected workflows, real-time data, and powerful analytics transform the maintenance and management of buildings and other mission-critical physical assets to supercharge productivity and minimize downtime.
Next-generation facilities and asset management.
Industry-leading test and measurement tools.
Intelligent construction costing and operations.
Advanced gas detection and safety monitoring.
Peace of mind through peak performance.
Our businesses span the globe, driving impact across mission-critical industries.
Most Valuable Washington Brands (Brand Finance)
years in a row on Newsweek's Most Responsible Companies list

raw_blocks: Protecting patients during their most critical moments.

Every day, millions of people around the world visit a healthcare facility. The care and handling of instruments used to treat patients is vital to their health outcome, and there’s no room for error.

Advanced Sterilization Products (ASP) is a leader in infection prevention, dedicated to creating the products, solutions, and processes needed by practitioners to protect patients during their most critical moments. Our ultimate responsibility is to the patient—it’s our job to elevate the standard of care for patients everywhere, and we are committed to continuously advancing infection prevention technologies that healthcare depends upon.
33 Technology Drive Irvine, CA 92618 USA +1-888-783-7723

“Together with our customers, ASP is forging a path towards a more resilient and empowered healthcare workforce, ensuring optimal patient care and a sustainable healthcare system. We are driven to do our part as leaders in sterilization.”
hospital patients has at least one healthcare-associated infection
